STEP4_HUD_ANIMATION_PHASES_2026-08-04.closes: The STILL_OPEN item 'the meaning of 0x800B0188/18C/190 (the three halfwords the non-completion path writes 0x400 into)'.
STEP4_HUD_ANIMATION_PHASES_2026-08-04.what_they_are: PER-HUD-ELEMENT ANIMATION PHASE COUNTERS. Each runs a 0..0x1000 cycle advanced once per frame by the HUD stage's own argument (s3), with 0x400 as the significant point.

per_element.0x800B0188: LIVES. At phase == exactly 0x400 it latches the live value of 0x800A65A0 into the display slot; the phase then advances by s3 and resets to 0 once it passes the 0x1000 bound.
per_element.0x800B018C: GRAIN. Identical shape, latching 0x800A65A1, whose tens/units digits are split with the 0xCCCCCCCD divide-by-10 reciprocal -- the same trick the results screen uses for its counters.
per_element.0x800B0190: NOT a latch: it drives a piecewise RAMP. phase >= 0xC01 subtracts 0x800 (falling limb); else phase >= 0x401 clamps to 0x400 (plateau); the result is then doubled. So it rises, holds, and falls -- an animation MAGNITUDE.

STEP4_HUD_ANIMATION_PHASES_2026-08-04.why_the_transition_write_makes_sense: Forcing all three to 0x400 puts each element at its commit / peak point, which is what a non-completion transition wants: freeze the HUD showing current values rather than mid-animation.
STEP4_HUD_ANIMATION_PHASES_2026-08-04.fourth_instance_of_the_head_idiom: These halfwords are also written and read by 0x80054EB4 -- the body behind the already-Canon 8-byte head grain_pickup_handler 0x80054EAC. That is a FOURTH instance of this codebase's 8-byte-head-then-fall-through idiom, after 0x800526F4 (this row), 0x8004F478, and C05's 0x80051938. Worth treating as a recognised pattern when reading any census entry: check whether the 'function' is really a body.

boss_question_answered_statically.method: Enumerated the COMPLETE global input/output set of FUNC_800B7DA0..0x800B8788 by walking every lui/load/store pair in the overlay image -- so the answer is exhaustive for that function, not a sample.
boss_question_answered_statically.reads: 0x80082258 (enemy total), 0x800822E4 + 0x80082412 (the pad edge pair), 0x800823A0 (goal latch), 0x8008245C (level index -- used SOLELY to index the unlock array), 0x8009B878 (unlock array), 0x800A658E (quota), 0x800A65A1 (grain), 0x800A65A2 (FLIK mask), 0x800BE444 (popcount table).
boss_question_answered_statically.result: THERE IS NO BOSS-SPECIFIC INPUT. No scene id beyond the array index, no boss globals (0x80090BEE Thumper, 0x800B4BA8 Hopper), no per-level table other than the unlock array and the popcount table. Boss stages therefore get the SAME results screen; the only per-level variation is that level's unlock byte and its enemy total 0x80082258. E13's 'boss/special-level differences' is answered from code and needed no fixtures.
boss_question_answered_statically.caveat: A bare 0x800A0000 also appears in the scan; that is an addressing artifact of lui+addu indexed forms (e.g. 0x800A0000-0x4788 = the unlock array), not a distinct global.

tile55_variant_identified_live.method: The header tile is re-read every frame INSIDE the results loop (0x800B7FC0), so a poke flips it on the same screen -- a far cleaner A/B than the C05 marker case. Isolated Interpreter instance /tmp/dsrepro-e13-header-20260804 port 23660, replaying the existing LEVEL06 100% movie to the results screen, then writing 0 to the goal latch 0x800823A0.
tile55_variant_identified_live.result: CONFIRMED VISUALLY. Latch == 1 -> tile 54 -> the banner reads 'level complete'. Latch == 0 -> tile 55 -> the banner reads 'LEVEL TOTAL'. Same screen, same counters and tokens; only the banner text changes.
tile55_variant_identified_live.interpretation: 'level total' is the non-completion summary variant of the very same screen -- not a separate screen. Consistent with the HUD stage's own use of the latch, where a running transition with the latch clear parks the HUD animation phases at their commit point.
tile55_variant_identified_live.honest_limit: The pixel diff across the two captures is dominated by three frames of counter animation, so the diff number is not the evidence -- the cropped header images are. What produced 'level total' here was a forced latch value, not a naturally-reached non-completion; the natural path that leaves the latch clear was not exercised.
